text: {"summary":"During the cluster upgrade many replicas were evicted simultaneously, exceeding the desired disruption limits.","likely_cause":"Evictions were performed without respecting PodDisruptionBudgets or the built‑in rate‑limiting, causing voluntary disruptions to exceed the application’s tolerance.","confidence":"medium","next_action":"Create and apply appropriate PodDisruptionBudgets for affected applications; use kubectl drain (which calls the Eviction API and respects PDBs) for node upgrades; consider alternative upgrade options such as accepting downtime or failover to a replica cluster as outlined in the disruptive actions guide."}
